dataset: Corvallis monthly historical weather summary, February-May, 2009-2025
purpose: Coarse exogenous environment covariates for transportability stress testing

trial_location_basis.note: The field experiments were conducted in an experimental hop yard near Corvallis, Oregon.

extraction: Year-by-year monthly values were transcribed from the public history tables.
limitations: These are Corvallis-area monthly summaries, not measurements from the exact experimental hop yard.
Monthly aggregation is deliberately coarse relative to infection biology and application timing.
The weather table is therefore treated as an external transportability stress test, not as definitive causal exposure data.
